title: Go-To-Market Canvas
prompt:
Act as a go-to-market strategist.
What I am launching  :   [PRODUCT, SERVICE, OR NEW MARKET ENTRY]
Launch date target      :  [WHEN YOU WANT TO GO LIVE]
Resources available     :  [TEAM SIZE, BUDGET RANGE, CHANNELS]
Build a complete GTM Canvas:
TARGET SEGMENT     :  Who specifically - ICP description
VALUE PROP                :  Why this, why now, why us
CHANNELS                   :  How we reach them - ranked by priority
PRICING                        :  Model and rationale
SALES MOTION           :  Steps from awareness to closed deal
SUCCESS METRICS    :  The 3 numbers that define success
TIMELINE                     :  Key milestones for weeks 1, 2, 4, 8
Flag the highest-risk assumption in this GTM plan and suggest how to validate it before
full launch.
Go-To-Market Canvas
Pricing
Cost of products/services Success Metrics
Measures of launch
effectiveness
Launch Timeline
Schedule for market entry
Sales Motion
Strategy for customer
Channels
engagement
Distribution and
communication methods
PRO TIP
The highest-risk GTM assumption is almost always Channel, not product. Most founders
assume a channel will work before testing it. Before investing in a full launch, run a 2-
week channel test with minimal spend. Let data pick your primary channel, not your
preference.
